    SELECT
        o.order_id,
        o.items_ex_vat
    FROM orders o
    WHERE o.status = 'PAID'

      AND strftime('%Y-%m', o.paid_at) IN ('2026-02', '2026-03')

)

        (SUM(po.items_ex_vat) - COALESCE(SUM(re.refund_ex_vat), 0))
        / NULLIF(COUNT(po.order_id), 0)
    ) AS average_order_amount
FROM paid_orders po
LEFT JOIN refund_exvat re ON po.order_id = re.order_id
